gates.name: Node 24 readiness baseline
gates.evidence: Community CI, release, security, governance, and verification workflows use Node 24-ready actions.

gates.name: Signed artifact verification
gates.evidence: Final SHA-256 checksums, detached signatures, and keyless attestation links must be recorded after artifacts exist.

gates.name: Provenance evidence
gates.evidence: SBOM metadata and SLSA provenance must be recorded after the release workflow produces artifacts.

gates.name: Announcement readiness
gates.evidence: README, wiki navigation, release index, readiness dashboard, and release notes point to the RC1 dry-run record.

gates.name: Public boundary
gates.evidence: Boundary validation remains required before final publication.

accepted_risks.reason: This packet prepares RC1 publication before the final community-v1.0.0-rc.1 tag and artifacts exist.
accepted_risks.exit_condition: Publish RC1 artifacts and record checksums, signatures, provenance, GitHub Release links, clean install smoke, and post-publication verification.

decision.summary: The public Community v1.0.0 RC1 publication path is ready as a dry-run record. Real artifacts and post-publication verification are still required before announcement.

next_recommendation: Publish Community v1.0.0 release-candidate artifacts from the completed Node 24 readiness baseline and record signed artifact checksums, provenance, GitHub Release links, and post-publication verification evidence.
